package.name: as2_mocap_guarded
package.description: S1: a hardened fork of the Aerostack2 as2_state_estimator `mocap_pose` plugin. Drops messages whose configured rigid body is absent instead of publishing the origin, takes earth->map from parameters (identity by default) instead of latching it from the first sample received, validates incoming samples, filters the differentiated velocity by default, and publishes a mocap_health topic. Sits alongside the stock as2_state_estimator; does not modify it.
